newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: COLOMBIA PESO FALLS VS DLR IN SPECULATED MARKET.
newsitem.headline: COLOMBIA PESO FALLS VS DLR IN SPECULATED MARKET.

text.p: Colombia's peso continued its slide falling 2.15 pesos to 1,119.65 against the dollar, interbank dealers said.
Dealers reported little demand for greenbacks from industry but said bank speculation drove down the peso.

The peso opened at 1,119.25 and its traded between an intraday high of 1,116.4 and a low of 1,120. Trading was slow after Thursday's bank holiday, with dealers reporting 362 transactions worth just $101 million, compared to the daily average of about $180 million.
